sentences.en: She is an American Board of Sleep Medicine Diplomate who has been working at the sleep center for more than 20 years.

sentences.en: Dr. Sanjay Grover is a Board Certified plastic surgeon and is a Diplomate of the American Board of Plastic Surgery.

sentences.en: Finding a sleep dentist in California is easy, but you may want to consider one that is a diplomate of the American Academy of Dental Sleep Medicine.
